Hi Hannah,

Quick question from the Acme procurement/security team as we wrap the SIG exchange: we need to confirm your latest external penetration test details. Specifically:

- Date of the test and whether the full report or a redacted copy can be shared. Our policy prefers reports no older than 12 months at time of contract signature.
- Vendor credentials: does the testing firm have recognized accreditations (e.g., CREST, OSCP, CREST-affiliated folks) and can you share a short vendor CV or company creds?
- High-level methodology (external network, authenticated web app, mobile, social engineering scope if any).
- Current remediation status: are findings verified fixed, mitigated, or pending retest? If the report is outside our 12-month window, would you consider an attestation letter plus a scheduled retest?

If you can share a redacted copy plus a vendor attestation, that would speed procurement. Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Maya Singh

Hannah — details below for the email to Acme. I pulled the artifacts and verified vendor creds.

Summary (for Acme):
- Report date: 2025-11-20 (external + authenticated web application assessment). BrightGate Security performed the engagement.
- Scope: external network scanning and exploitation, authenticated web application testing (OWASP Top 10 focus), session management, API surface. No social-engineering was in scope; internal host testing limited to staging.
- Methodology: BrightGate follows a hybrid methodology mapped to OWASP and PTES; they performed automated discovery, manual verification of findings, credentialed testing for web endpoints, and proof-of-concept exploit writeups for high/critical items. They provide vulnerability reproductions and remediation recommendations. Their final report includes evidence (screenshots, curl traces) — we will supply a redacted PDF excluding customer-identifying data and internal IPs.
- Vendor creds: BrightGate Security — CREST-aligned consultants; company holds ISO 27001; lead tester (S. Park) holds OSCP and CREST practitioner certifications. I attached their one-page creds. BrightGate has done similar SaaS infra engagements (references available on request).
- Remediation status: most high and critical items were remediated and verified by BrightGate during a verification pass in 2026-01. Medium items: 3 marked as mitigated with follow-ups (WAF tuning, dependency upgrade). One low finding remains open (3rd-party library update scheduled). We can provide a remediation summary and verification screenshots.
- Retest cadence / report age: current full report is dated 2025-11-20. Acme's 12-month rule would normally require a retest before signature if the report is older than 12 months. We ran the verification pass in 2026-01 which reduced residual risk. We can offer: (A) provide the redacted 2025-11-20 report + remediation verification letter (signed by our Head of Security) and a commitment to a retest scheduled for 2026-10-05; or (B) if Acme requires a completed retest now, we can prioritize a short external-surface re-audit but that would require a quoted SOW and 3-4 week lead time.

Attachments I can produce immediately for Acme: redacted-pentest-20251120.pdf (redacted), brightgate-creds.pdf, and a formal attestation-letter-acme-20260811.pdf that states remediation verification and retest schedule.

Let me know which option you want me to send — I recommend option A (redacted report + attestation + scheduled retest) because it's the fastest for procurement and keeps workload reasonable.

Rishi
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
